name: individuality-examples
description: Runnable TypeScript examples for performing calls against a People chain (PNPM + tsx + PAPI).

scripts.spec:people: polkadot-omni-node chain-spec-builder -c generated/people-chain-spec.json create --relay-chain rococo --para-id 1502 --runtime ../../target/release/wbuild/next-people-paseo-runtime/next_people_paseo_runtime.compact.compressed.wasm named-preset local_testnet
scripts.spec:assethub: polkadot-omni-node chain-spec-builder -c generated/ah-chain-spec.json create --relay-chain rococo --para-id 1500 --runtime ../../target/release/wbuild/next-asset-hub-paseo-runtime/next_asset_hub_paseo_runtime.compact.compressed.wasm named-preset local_testnet
scripts.node:people: pnpm run build:people-runtime && pnpm run spec:people && zombienet spawn people-network.toml --provider native
scripts.node:assethub: pnpm run build:people-runtime && pnpm run build:ah-runtime && pnpm run spec:people && pnpm run spec:assethub && zombienet spawn assethub-network.toml --provider native
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm run hrmp && pnpm run chunks && pnpm run subscribe && pnpm run onboarding
scripts.bootstrap:assethub: pnpm run hrmp && pnpm run chunks && pnpm run subscribe:assethub && ONBOARDING_SIZE=1 pnpm run onboarding
